name: Mika Nishima
source: When seeing Mika for the first time you’d be thinking you are dealing with a child as she looks very young and is doing everything to maintain the illusion. Her things are magic, anything out of the ordinary, paranormal, fantasy. She refuses to grow up and remains in her childish world.
translation: When seeing Mika for the first time you’d be thinking you are dealing with a child as she looks very young and is doing everything to maintain the illusion. Her things are magic, anything out of the ordinary, paranormal, fantasy. She refuses to grow up and remains in her childish world.
